reviews.title: Good product at a reasonable price:  Perfect!
reviews.text:
I grew up with thinner, lighter weight washcloths and towels,  and as a result, prefer them to their heavier, plush counterparts.  The thinner ones, like these Mainstays 18-Pack Washcloth Bundle, True Bright, dry faster and just feel better on my skin.  And these are priced right and in attractive colors.

In addition to using them for their intended purpose, they can be used as dustcloths and shop towels as well.  I have even used them as backdrops for taking photos of some smaller objects where they can provide vivid color and texture contrast.  

Whatever your uses, I think you'll find these to be a good product at a reasonable price.

reviews.title: Perfect for My Taste in Washcloths
reviews.text: I love these washcloths. I have no interest in matchy-matchy bathroom decor. I don't care if my towels and washcloths go together. I only care that they are clean and in good shape. I'm super picky about materials used in washcloths. I don't like them to be overly thick or thin. I can't stand the velvety type. These are perfect in every way. Great size and thickness. I like the color assortment and the generous package quantity. Super price on these!

reviews.title: Handy dandy washcloths!
reviews.text: These washcloths are so valuable in my home. I have a large family so they come in handy for many things. My favorite is to keep a basket full of them in the kitchen for spills and for cleaning. They come with so many at such a great price that I highly recommend buying a couple of pack to have at home. Very handy!

reviews.title: Way better than chuncky washcloths!
reviews.text: I have been buying these for 32 years. They work for kitchen, bath, cleaning everything. They are white so they can be bleached. If they get too dirty I throw it away. These are a main item I have in my house always. For the price I can replace them easily without breaking the budget. I hate thick washcloths since I've been using these. The ones for the bathroom I wash and use fabric softener for perfect thickness washcloths.

reviews.title: Great inexpensive wash cloths
reviews.text: Like the packs of white Mainstay wash cloths, these 100% cotton cloths are perfect for the many jobs they help me with around the house, especially in the kitchen. I was bored of the white ones so got some colored ones. Nice change of pace. Just wish fewer of them were white. I like the varied colors, but there are more white cloths than the photo indicates. Note that they are fairly thin but not Temu thin. If you're looking for luxury, look elsewhere, but I love these for the price and good-enough quality. Will buy more as needed. I always have a pile of them waiting to be laundered, so I like to keep a good supply of these gems.

reviews.title: Value bundle
reviews.text: We buy these washrags aa few times a year and use them for everything from bathing to cleaning. You just can't beat the price and the amount of rags in the bundle. Will continue to purchase these.

reviews.title: The Ultimate Multi-Tasker! (And an absolute steal)
reviews.text: I am obsessed with this 18-pack of Mainstays washcloths! My absolute favorite use for them is removing my makeup at the end of the day, but they are true household MVPs. From bathing to wiping down kitchen counters and tackling tough, messy cleaning jobs, they do it all. Because they are so inexpensive, I don't feel guilty tossing one out if it gets completely ruined during a deep clean. They are machine washable, and while they do start to thin out after several washes, it's honestly not a dealbreaker when you get 18 in a pack! For the price and quality, you cannot beat the value. Highly recommend grabbing a pack (or two) for literally everything!

reviews.title: Surpassed my expectations!More than just a generic
reviews.text:
I originally bought this Mainstays 18-Pack of White Washcloths just needing something cheap for messy cleanups, but I am genuinely impressed by the quality.
For Walmart's everyday low prices, I expected thin, rough rags. Instead, these are surprisingly soft, absorbent, and hold up perfectly in the washing machine without fraying or falling apart. Mainstays has really proven itself to be more than just a standard generic brand—they deliver true, reliable quality that rivals much more expensive department store towels.
Perfect for everyday use, skincare, or cleaning. At this price point and quality, you absolutely cannot beat the value! Highly recommend.
